title: Preparation of co-crystals of human PPARα-LBD and ligand for high-resolution X-ray crystallography
protocol: Dilute ligand stock solution with Buffer A.
Mix 25 μL each of hPPARα-LBD solution (20 mg/mL in Buffer A) and the ligand solution in a 1.5-mL plastic tube on ice.
Dispense 200 μL of Crystallization Buffer to each well of an EasyXtal 15-Well Tool X-Seal plate at 4°C.
Mix 1 μL of Crystallization Buffer and 1 μL hPPARα-LBD-ligand mixed solution on the backside of the screw cap at 4°C.
Fasten the screw cap.
Incubate the plate at 4°C.
Dilute ligand stock solution with Buffer A.
Mix 25 μL of hPPARα-LBD solution (20 mg/mL in Buffer A) with 25 μL of ligand solution in a 1.5-mL plastic tube on ice.
Dispense 200 μL of Crystallization Buffer to each well of an EasyXtal 15-Well Tool X-Seal plate at 4°C.
Mix 1 μL of Crystallization Buffer with 1 μL of the PPAR-ligand mixed solution on the backside of the screw cap at 4°C.
Fasten the screw cap.
Crush seed crystals (Wy14643 or iFA-bound crystals) in 10 μL of Crystallization Buffer using a needle tip at 4°C to create crystal nuclei.
Transfer the crystal nuclei via a single streak with a human hair to 2 μL mixture of hPPARα-LBD/ligand in Crystallization Buffer at 4°C.
Incubate the plate at 4°C.
Perform steps in the cold room (4°C).
Prepare iFA-bound crystals by cross-seeding.
Dilute ligand stock solution with Soaking Buffer.
Try initial dilution at 1 mM.
Dispense 200 μL Soaking Buffer to each well of an EasyXtal 15-Well Tool X-Seal plate at 4°C.
Place 5 μL ligand solution (in Soaking Buffer) on the backside of the screw cap at 4°C.
Pick up the iFA-bound crystals with a CryoLoop at 4°C.
Wash the crystals with Soaking Buffer.
Soak the crystals in 5 μL ligand solution at 4°C.
Fasten the screw cap.
Incubate the plate at 4°C.
Mix 400 μL of Crystallization Buffer with 100 μL of 100% glycerol in a 1.5 mL plastic tube.
Make 5 μL drops of the resulting Cryoprotection Buffer on the backside of the screw cap of an EasyXtal 15-Well Tool X-Seal plate at 4°C.
Pick up crystals with a CryoLoop.
Soak the picked-up crystals into Cryoprotection Buffer at 4°C.
Freeze the soaked crystals under liquid nitrogen until X-ray diffraction data collection.
